definition: The requirement that security, legal, and access constraints must be satisfied before any optimization (cost, speed) is considered during job placement.
A stable allocator-specific identifier for an execution node, distinct from its network endpoint or provider resource ID.
The mechanism provided by Runtime Reference to bind a semantic operation to either a local or remote implementation.
A declared, finite ability of a node (e.g., installed CPU/RAM) that remains distinct from transient capacity observations.
